notes.title: Update Incoming:Margaret’s New Chapter and the Protagonist’s Identity Revealed!
notes.notes: [p][b]New Update Incoming: Margaret’s New Chapter and the Protagonist’s Identity Revealed![/b][/p][p][b]Dear Players,[/b] [/p][p]Are you ready to embark on a journey that will reshape destiny? We’re thrilled to announce a major update for [i]Happy Island Fantasy[/i], featuring Margaret’s heart-pounding Happy Ending storyline and a shocking revelation about the protagonist’s mysterious identity! This time, darkness will give way to light, and the story will be yours to write![/p][h3][b]Margaret’s New Chapter[/b] [/h3][p]In the previous storyline, Margaret fell under the control of a succubus, her body overtaken, and the world plunged into lascivious chaos... But everything is about to change! In this update, Margaret will finally embrace her Happy Ending! Your choices will lead to unexpected plot twists![/p][h3][b]The Protagonist’s True Identity Revealed[/b] [/h3][p]This time, the truth hidden in the mist will be unveiled! “What secrets does Happy Island hold?” “Who am I, really?” “Why am I caught in this vortex of fate?” The hidden truth will completely overturn your understanding of the entire story! Get ready for a breathtaking plot climax and explore the secrets woven by fate![/p][p][b]Update Release Date[/b]: Coming soon on \[September 19]![/p][p][b]Stay Connected[/b]: Follow us on \[[url="https://steamcommunity.com/chat/invite/TLxftwYf" style="button"]Steam Community[/url]/[url="https://discord.com/invite/fcCRZ4JfdY" style="button"]Discord[/url]] for the latest news and share your excitement with other players! Are you ready for this heart-racing story? Margaret and the protagonist’s fate await you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653024/67995cecabcd634b34b19ca26f5d9d700dcee825.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653024/9b0cdd9a4152976894a2b33cf122dec40016c846.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653024/88a962ad5943a454d2645315eca38c87de2171b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653024/b9c5b46f0d6885d50b572a6e17e30ffc1944d273.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Character "Luna" Now Live! Dive In and Share Your Thoughts!
notes.notes: [p]Game Update Announcement[/p][p]【1】This update introduces our New character—Luna! As the director of the Plant Research Institute, she is a master of botany, highly knowledgeable, and comes with a captivating storyline. Interact with Luna to explore her intriguing narrative and enjoy enriched game content![/p][p]Bug Fixes[/p][p]【1】Fixed the issue where other interfaces would pop up while planting plants.[/p][p]【2】Fixed the issue where the Happiness Handbook reward could not be claimed after completing Ashley’s storyline.[/p][p]【3】Fixed the occasional issue where the next event could not be activated after completing an event.[/p][p]【4】Fixed the occasional issue where the mouse could not move after switching screens.[/p][p]Feature Optimizations[/p][p]【1】Added mini-map display for the sheep-finding task.[/p][p]【2】Added the ability to change the player’s nickname in the library.[/p][p]【3】Adjusted 5 cooking functions to grant special Buffs to the protagonist after use.[/p][p]【4】Added a completion marker for crafted recipes.[/p][p]【5】After completing Luna’s event, she will water the farmland in front of the Plant Research Institute.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653024/b0483252fcfc24d8be2b653b5d452c541b8250bf.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Game Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
[1]Fixed the issue of insufficient initial stamina in the Modern Chapter.
[2]Fixed the issue where some task rewards were not received and task costs were not deducted.

Feature Optimizations
[1]Optimized known audio and text issues.
[2]Added directional key control for the sleep and quiz interfaces.
[3]Added regional divisions to the mini-map in the Modern Chapter for easier location finding.
[4]Added confirmation functions for certain features using the "E" key and "Space" key.
[5]Reduced the difficulty of certain task requirements.

notes.title: Game Update Announcement
notes.notes:

[2] Optimized the flow of some prequel missions.

notes.title: Game Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Feature Optimizations

【1】Added support for Russian, Thai, French, and Spanish text display.
【2】Adjusted the homepage UI layout and wording based on player feedback.

Bug Fixes

【1】Fixed an issue where sowing seeds during fast movement caused failure and seed disappearance.
【2】Fixed an issue where certain achievements could not be completed.

notes.title: Game Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
1.Fixed an issue in the sports arena racing minigame where players could not win at 720p resolution.
2.Fixed a display error in the interface after reaching the maximum experience level for jobs.
3.Fixed an issue where the fishing sound effect would play repeatedly and not stop after upgrading skills.
4.Fixed a display error for extra experience points gained from jobs after upgrading skills.
5.Fixed an issue in the fishing competition where catching 5 fish with only 5 baits was still judged as a failure.
6.Fixed a crash caused by pressing ESC on the first sleep interface in the modern chapter.
7.Fixed an issue in the Happiness Handbook where multiple purchases could not complete tasks.
8.Fixed an issue in the Happiness Handbook where completing character story rewards did not correctly grant coins.
9.Fixed an issue where cloud save data was not uploading.

Feature Optimizations
1.Optimized Ashley's story quest: after entering a bad ending, players can now return to the quest to achieve a good ending.
2.Optimized fishing content: museum fish catalog now divided into three categories, reduced number of fish bite attempts, and increased spawn rates for all fish types.
3.Optimized task difficulty in the story progression, e.g., reduced the requirement from 3 crucian carp to 1.
4.Fixed text errors in some parts of the game.

Attempted Fixes
1.Attempted to fix an issue where the mouse would get stuck for some players when switching screen states.
